info.name: Get a paginated list of SLOs

params.name: spaceId
params.description: An identifier for the space. If `/s/` and the identifier are omitted from the path, the default space is used.

params.name: kqlQuery
params.description: A valid kql query to filter the SLO with

params.name: size
params.description: The page size to use for cursor-based pagination, must be greater or equal than 1

params.name: searchAfter
params.description: The cursor to use for fetching the results from, when using a cursor-base pagination.

params.name: page
params.description: The page to use for pagination, must be greater or equal than 1

params.name: perPage
params.description: Number of SLOs returned by page

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Sort by field

params.name: sortDirection
params.description: Sort order

params.name: hideStale
params.description: Hide stale SLOs from the list as defined by stale SLO threshold in SLO settings

items.docs: You must have the `read` privileges for the **SLOs** feature in the **Observability** section of the Kibana feature privileges.

params.description: An identifier for the space. If `/s/` and the identifier are omitted from the path, the default space is used.

info.name: Bulk delete SLO definitions and their associated summary and rollup data.

params.name: spaceId
params.description: An identifier for the space. If `/s/` and the identifier are omitted from the path, the default space is used.

items.docs: Bulk delete SLO definitions and their associated summary and rollup data.  This endpoint initiates a bulk deletion operation for SLOs, which may take some time to complete.  The status of the operation can be checked using the `GET /api/slo/_bulk_delete/{taskId}` endpoint.

info.name: Retrieve the status of the bulk deletion

params.name: spaceId
params.description: An identifier for the space. If `/s/` and the identifier are omitted from the path, the default space is used.

params.name: taskId
params.description: The task id of the bulk delete operation

items.docs: Retrieve the status of the bulk deletion operation for SLOs.  This endpoint returns the status of the bulk deletion operation, including whether it is completed and the results of the operation.

info.name: Batch delete rollup and summary data

params.name: spaceId
params.description: An identifier for the space. If `/s/` and the identifier are omitted from the path, the default space is used.

items.docs: The deletion occurs for the specified list of `sloId`. You must have `all` privileges for the **SLOs** feature in the **Observability** section of the Kibana feature privileges.
